title: 리딩인사이드 스타터 UNIT 12 Environment 문장
source: Reading Inside Starter Answer Key — 구문 해설 인용문 + 워크북 WRITING TEST 정답 청크(해석은 교재 해석 발췌)

grammar.evidence: R1 Check Up: if / because · R2 Check Up: 목적어 / 보어(that절의 역할) · WB GRAMMAR TEST A if/Because/that/that, B that/that/because/if, C 눈이 많이 온다면 / 열심히 일했기 때문에 / ~해야 한다는 것이다

sentences.title: Two out of a Thousand
sentences.en: They are attacked by other animals, and half of them are eaten.
sentences.ko: 그들은 다른 동물들에 의해 공격받고, 그들의 절반은 잡아먹힌다.

sentences.title: Two out of a Thousand
sentences.en: After they reach the water, the last 400 turtles are still in danger …
sentences.ko: 바다에 도달한 후에, 마지막 남은 400마리의 거북이들은 여전히 위험에 처해 있다.

sentences.title: Two out of a Thousand
sentences.en: Normally, about 20 of these adults survive and return to the beach to breed.
sentences.ko: 보통, 다 자란 이 거북이들 중 20마리 정도가 살아남아 알을 낳기 위해 해변으로 돌아간다.
sentences.target: return to the beach to breed

sentences.title: Two out of a Thousand
sentences.en: … pollution reduce the number of surviving adult sea turtles to just two.
sentences.ko: 오염이 살아남은 다 자란 바다거북의 수를 고작 두 마리로 줄여 버린다.

sentences.title: Two out of a Thousand
sentences.en: Survival has always been difficult for sea turtles.

sentences.title: Two out of a Thousand
sentences.en: But humans are making the problem much worse.
sentences.ko: 하지만 인간이 그 문제를 훨씬 더 악화시키고 있다.

sentences.title: The Art of Erasing
sentences.en: But did you know that it’s also possible to create graffiti by erasing something?
sentences.ko: 하지만 무언가를 지움으로써 그라피티를 만들어 내는 것도 가능하다는 것을 알고 있었는가?

sentences.title: The Art of Erasing
sentences.en: Reverse graffiti, also known as clean graffiti, literally reverses the idea …
sentences.ko: 리버스 그라피티는, 깨끗한 그라피티라고도 알려져 있으며, 문자 그대로 발상을 뒤집는다.

sentences.title: The Art of Erasing
sentences.en: Images are made by the contrast between the clean part and the dirty part.
sentences.ko: 이미지는 깨끗한 부분과 더러운 부분 간의 대조에 의해 만들어진다.
sentences.point: 수동태 be+v-ed+by / between A and B

sentences.title: The Art of Erasing
sentences.en: Reverse graffiti has been seen on dirty road signs …, and this new trend is spreading …
sentences.ko: 리버스 그라피티는 더러운 도로 표지판에서 발견되어왔는데, 이 새로운 추세는 확산되고 있다.
sentences.target: has been seen on dirty road signs

quiz.q: ____ you don’t get up early, you will be late for school. (만약 ~라면)
She was very tired ____ she worked too hard. (~ 때문에)
I think ____ reverse graffiti is environmentally friendly. (~라는 것)
If it ____ tomorrow, we will stay home. (rain)
Sea turtles are in danger (because / that) predators attack them.
(That / Because) reverse graffiti uses no paint, it is eco-friendly.
(If / That) you help us, we can clean the beach.
If it will snow tomorrow, I will make a snowman.
quiz.a: If it snows tomorrow, I will make a snowman.
